requires: traceable saved facts, all valid/invalid/conflict counts preserved

EXECUTION_ELIGIBLE.not_a_claim: does not prove unseen policy benefit

evidence_grade.REPLICATED_LOCAL_OBSERVATION: same-start registered repeated observations consistent, no contrary valid result
evidence_grade.CROSS_START_SUPPORT: same predeclared predicate/action family supported at distinct non-near-duplicate starts; source groups counted separately

review.fact_audit: program exact numbers, units, denominators, references and raw response; preserve cost and invalid/negative evidence
review.scope_review: observable registered predicates, no ID/rank shortcut or single-attribute causality from multiattribute intervention
review.content_review: at least one concrete candidate distinction and falsifiable scoped consequence, not generic reminder
review.independence: separate from generator; blinded to current/eval terminal outcomes and retriever acceptance; disclose human authorship/executor conflicts; no generator self-approval
review.disagreement: UNKNOWN/PENDING; a third independent named reviewer may adjudicate once with preserved reasons, no silent majority override of factual error
review.deadline: JM2-B2 define rubric; roster/conflicts/signed acceptance frozen BEFORE JM2-C1 generation; no roster => DEFER
review.independent_model: NOT_SELECTED; if separately authorized must freeze model/prompt/budget <=8 before generation, never hide as retrieval overhead

minimum_coverage.shared_material_groups: cannot count as independent true sources; report both source labels and material connected components
minimum_coverage.nonempty_claim: requires actual nonempty training and dev support in claimed family
minimum_coverage.action_claim: requires exact same action-contrast category and both matched roles
minimum_coverage.missing_coverage: DEFER or narrower FACT_CASE, no winning resample

locked_retrieval_gate.precision_rule: observed macro-source applicable precision R1>=R0 on locked labels; UNKNOWN excluded from correctness and reported
locked_retrieval_gate.coverage: nonzero accepted labeled applicable examples in every predeclared family/stage/action stratum; all-empty => DEFER
locked_retrieval_gate.denominators: applicable/nonapplicable/UNKNOWN and abstentions/all candidates retained; missing source classes => DEFER
locked_retrieval_gate.error_interpretation: zero observed errors is a finite-screen rule, not proof true error rate zero; uncertainty descriptive unless independent-source inference preregistered
locked_retrieval_gate.deadline: rubric, source partitions, errors and strata before JM3-B1 labels; parameter values before lock reveal

local_execution_gate.all_starts: complete valid paired reference/suffixes and registered repeats in all required states; no unexplained in-scope contrary result or missing critical action
local_execution_gate.E_specific_increment: E action vs L-N, L-A and L-G must have identifiable retained-action comparisons; at least two distinct dev starts/two groups show primary-volume advantage >= frozen delta_local or consistent higher stable-completion tier; no start/repeat degrades stable completion or loading beyond v2 equivalence
local_execution_gate.T_route: T vs L-N likewise; T/E shared whitelist uses intersection of qualifications; no forced E if only T qualifies
local_execution_gate.no_action_difference: preserve same-action observation; no distinguishable increment => DEFER, not efficacy certificate
local_execution_gate.uncertainty: delta_local uses training resolution/noise, not local winners; two repeats screening only, no CI/stability proof

maintenance.change_public_text: new version/digest and repeat relevant review and applicability/local gates
maintenance.after_eval_freeze: read-only; no updates from test results
maintenance.conflict: do not erase with support-vote majority
